entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3786035184916139136: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56572: distance 49.364 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.013), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 49.364 +/- 0.642 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 20.1590 +/- 0.0285 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10), 708.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -11.535, 35.586 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.062 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56572: radius 1.062 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 0.872 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.048) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5415 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56572: effective temperature 5415 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.078).
